features_zh.name: 信仰庇護
features_zh.description: 你與同伴可在同信仰的神殿獲得免費治療與照料，但須自行提供法術材料。與你信仰相同的人可供你維持簡樸生活；你也可能與一座神殿有固定關係，獲得神職人員不至於危及自身的協助。

features_en.name: Shelter of the Faithful
features_en.description: You and your companions can receive free healing and care at temples of your faith, but must supply spell materials. Members of your faith support a modest lifestyle for you. A temple with which you have ties may provide assistance that does not endanger its clergy.

equipment_en: Tools of the con of your choice

features_zh.name: 假身分
features_zh.description: 你有第二身分，備妥文件、人脈與偽裝，可假扮該身分。只要見過範本的樣式或筆跡，也能偽造文件，包括正式文書及私人信件。

features_en.name: False Identity
features_en.description: You maintain a second identity with documents, contacts, and disguises. You can also forge documents, including official papers and personal letters, after seeing a sample of the document style or handwriting.

equipment_en: Dark common clothes including a hood

features_zh.name: 犯罪聯絡人
features_zh.description: 你有可靠的地下聯絡人，可協助在你與犯罪網路之間傳遞訊息。

features_en.name: Criminal Contact
features_en.description: You have a reliable underworld contact who can pass messages between you and a criminal network.

features_zh.name: 廣受歡迎
features_zh.description: 你通常能找到表演場所，以每天表演換取符合場所水準的免費食宿，生活水準為簡樸或舒適。曾欣賞並喜歡你表演的當地人，通常對你友善。

features_en.name: By Popular Demand
features_en.description: You can usually find a place to perform, earning free lodging and food of modest or comfortable quality by performing each night. Locals who have enjoyed your performances are generally friendly to you.

features_zh.name: 鄉野款待
features_zh.description: 平民會將你視為自己人；只要你未表現出對他們的危害，便願意提供躲藏、休息或休養的場所。他們會協助你躲避法律或追捕者，但不會為你冒生命危險。

features_en.name: Rustic Hospitality
features_en.description: Common folk see you as one of their own. Unless you threaten them, they offer places to hide, rest, or recover and help you evade the law or pursuers, but will not risk their lives for you.

equipment_en: Letter of introduction from your guild

features_zh.name: 公會會員
features_zh.description: 公會同業必要時可提供食宿，並可能協助你接觸有權勢的人、處理政治或法律問題；你通常須支付每月 5 gp 會費。若積欠會費，須補繳才能恢復公會支持。

features_en.name: Guild Membership
features_en.description: Guild members can provide food and lodging when needed and may help with influential contacts or political and legal matters. Dues normally cost 5 gp per month; unpaid dues must be made up before guild support resumes.

features_zh.name: 發現
features_zh.description: 你的隱居生活帶來一項重要發現；其具體內容由你與 DM 決定。

features_en.name: Discovery
features_en.description: Your isolated life gave you an important discovery; its specific nature is decided with the DM.

features_zh.name: 特權地位
features_zh.description: 你容易獲得上流社會接納，能進入高階社交圈，並可取得當地貴族的會面。平民通常試著讓你滿意，商人與旅店老闆也傾向給予禮遇。

features_en.name: Position of Privilege
features_en.description: You are readily accepted in high society, can enter elite circles, and can secure an audience with local nobles. Commoners generally try to accommodate you, and merchants and innkeepers tend to treat you with courtesy.

equipment_en: Trophy from an animal you killed

features_zh.name: 流浪者
features_zh.description: 你對地圖與地理有極佳記憶，能回想周遭地形、聚落及其他特徵。只要當地有漿果、小型獵物、飲水等資源，每天可為你與至多五名同伴找到足夠食物與飲水。

features_en.name: Wanderer
features_en.description: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography and can recall nearby terrain, settlements, and other features. If the land offers berries, small game, water, or similar resources, you can find enough food and water each day for yourself and up to five others.

equipment_zh: 已故同僚留下、記有未解問題的信件
equipment_en: Letter from a dead colleague posing an unanswered question

features_zh.name: 研究員
features_zh.description: 若你不知道某段知識，通常知道要去哪裡、向誰查找答案。

features_en.name: Researcher
features_en.description: When you do not know a piece of lore, you generally know where or from whom to seek the answer.

features_zh.name: 航程通行
features_zh.description: 你可為自己與同伴安排帆船的免費航程，通常透過你曾效力的船隻或熟識的人脈。但無法保證符合你的時間與目的地，途中也須協助船員工作。

features_en.name: Ship’s Passage
features_en.description: You can arrange free sailing passage for yourself and companions, usually through a former ship or contacts. The timing and destination need not match your plans, and you are expected to help the crew during the voyage.

features_zh.name: 軍階
features_zh.description: 你在曾效力的軍事組織中仍有軍階；較低階的士兵通常服從你。你可藉軍階暫時徵用簡單裝備或馬匹，也通常能進入組織認可你的友方軍營與堡壘。

features_en.name: Military Rank
features_en.description: You retain a rank in your former military organization, and lower-ranking soldiers generally defer to you. You may invoke it to requisition simple equipment or horses temporarily and usually gain entry to friendly camps and fortresses where your rank is recognized.

equipment_en: Token to remember your parents by

features_zh.name: 城市祕密
features_zh.description: 你熟悉城市的祕徑與暗巷。非戰鬥時，你獨自行動，或由你帶領同伴時，可在同一城市的兩個地點之間以一般兩倍速度移動。

features_en.name: City Secrets
features_en.description: You know a city’s hidden routes and alleys. Outside combat, you can travel between two locations in the same city twice as fast as usual when alone or when leading your companions.
